newsitem.title: USA: Atmos rate settlement allowed to proceed.
newsitem.headline: Atmos rate settlement allowed to proceed.

text.p: Atmos Energy Corp said Thursday the suspension period affecting its West Texas natural gas rate request has expired.
All cities have either approved, or taken no action to reject, a settlement allowing a $5.3 million increase in annual revenues to be effective for bills rendered on and after Nov. 1, 1996.
The settlement was recommended by the steering committee representing the 67 affected cities. In May 1996, the company filed to increase revenues by about $7.7 million.
As a part of the settlement, the company said, it agreed not to seek another increase before June 1998.
